subject: general
question: A can finish a piece of work in 48 days and B can finish it in 60 days. They work together for 12 days and then A goes away. In how much time (in days and hours) will B finish 25% of the remaining work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1538b9fda95f2b9bcb55dcc72d474e2d4dc2c4c26bd16d6a99f895b8201b1467.png] __**

Total work = 240 (LCM of 48 and 60)

Efficiency = Work/Time

A and B complete in 12 days = 12 × (5 + 4) = 108 work

25% of the remaining work = (240 - 108)/4 = 33 work
